findings.issue: The eligibility checks use `pots.every(...)`, which pass vacuously if `pots` is empty. For the flop fold (line 66) a neighbouring `pots[0]?.amount` assertion guards against that, but the blind-fold check at line 86 has no such guard.
findings.evidence: Line 86: `expect(blindFold.pots.every((pot) => pot.eligible.join() === '1,3,4,5,6')).toBe(true);` and no assertion on blindFold.pots length/amount. The engine always builds pots[0] today (src/engine/hand.ts:213), so this is robustness, not a current miss.
findings.fix: Add `expect(blindFold.pots.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);` before line 86 (or assert `blindFold.pots[0]?.eligible` equals [1,3,4,5,6] alongside the every-check).

summary: Test-only change: one new file of 112 lines, within budget; no src/ or existing-test edits. All three SPEC items are implemented with the worked values from spec section 5, and each listed mutation probe would fail its named test: dropping the third kicker gives compare 0 instead of 1; keeping pots on fold leaves 4 in eligible; leaving totalContribution unchanged breaks seat 4 == 4 and totalIn == 44; changing > to >= makes createHand throw for SB == BB. The new file passes locally (3/3) and gate build-1 passes. One MINOR robustness note on a vacuous every() check. No BLOCKER or MAJOR.
